_comment: Curated regulatory reference dataset based on FSSAI (Advertising and Claims) Regulations 2018 and CCPA Consumer Protection rulings. Used by Reality-Check and Credibility-Weighting Agents.

regulations.regulation_ref: FSSAI Advertising and Claims Reg. 2018, Schedule I
regulations.criteria: No added sugars (sucrose, glucose, fructose, syrups, honey).

regulations.regulation_ref: FSSAI Advertising and Claims Reg. 2018, Schedule V
regulations.criteria: Only single food or natural ingredients without additives or artificial chemical processing.

regulations.regulation_ref: FSSAI Advertising and Claims Reg. 2018, Reg 4(5)
regulations.criteria: Product must contain zero added preservatives or artificial additives.

regulations.regulation_ref: FSSAI (Food Products Standards & Food Additives) Reg. 2011 & Claims 2018
regulations.criteria: Gluten content < 20 mg/kg; ingredients must not contain gluten-bearing grains without certified processing.

regulations.regulation_ref: FSSAI Advertising and Claims Reg. 2018, Schedule I
regulations.criteria: Fat content must not exceed 3g per 100g for solids.

regulations.regulation_ref: FSSAI Advertising and Claims Reg. 2018, Schedule I
regulations.criteria: Protein content must provide at least 20% of energy or >= 10g per 100g.

rulings.ruling_summary: CCPA / FSSAI enforcement action against packaged coconut water brands claiming '100% Natural / Raw' while adding bio-preservatives (nisin, citric acid) and added sugars.
rulings.enforcement_standard: Products containing added additives or sugars cannot claim 100% natural.

rulings.ruling_summary: CCPA and FSSAI advisory prohibiting misleading generic health and immunity boosting claims on commercial drinks without pre-approved clinical validation.
rulings.enforcement_standard: Generic 'immunity booster' claims on high-sugar or ultra-processed foods are deemed deceptive unless specific micro-nutrient RDA standards are met.
